title.zh: 气氛与整合：温度相同，化学反应可能完全不同
title.en: Ambient and integration: identical temperatures can produce entirely different chemistry

subtitle.zh: 惰性、氧化、还原与氢钝化不能混用
subtitle.en: Inert protection, oxidation, reduction and hydrogen passivation are not interchangeable

body.zh: 退火气氛不仅防污染，还可能参与氧化、还原、氮化、相形成或界面缺陷钝化。
body.en: Annealing ambients prevent contamination and may also participate in oxidation, reduction, nitridation, phase formation or interface-defect passivation.

body.zh: N₂ / Ar常用于惰性保护与减少非目标反应
body.en: N₂ / Ar Commonly used for inert protection And reducing unintended reactions

body.zh: O₂ / 氧化性气氛用于受控氧化或调整界面
body.en: O₂ / oxidizing ambient Used for controlled oxidation Or interface modification

body.zh: 形成气Forming Gas含氢气氛，用于部分界面缺陷钝化
body.en: Forming gas Forming Gas A hydrogen-containing ambient used for Passivation of some interface defects

body.zh: 真空 / 低压降低部分气相反应，但需控制挥发和残留
body.en: Vacuum / low pressure Reduces some gas-phase reactions, But evaporation and residues must be controlled

body.zh: 专用反应气氛按材料执行氮化、还原或特定界面处理
body.en: Dedicated reactive ambient Used for material-specific nitridation, Reduction or interface treatment

body.zh: 术语卡：Forming Gas Anneal=气氛+工艺目的，不是与RTA、Flash、Laser并列的热源类别。
body.en: Terminology: Forming Gas Anneal = ambient + process purpose; It is not a heat-source category parallel to RTA, Flash or Laser.

body.zh: 在不同热处理平台中采用合适气氛
body.en: Use appropriate ambients on different thermal-processing platforms

body.zh: 其他适配平台按材料与安全条件确认
body.en: Other compatible platforms Confirm material and safety compatibility
Confirm the material stack And target

body.zh: 气体纯度高纯气体与洁净管路减少引入杂质风险。
body.en: Gas purity High-purity gases and clean lines Reduce the risk of introducing impurities.

body.zh: O₂ H₂O残余O₂ / H₂O影响氧化、羟基化、氢化等反应路径。
body.en: O₂ H₂O Residual O₂ / H₂O Affect oxidation, hydroxylation, Hydrogenation and other reaction pathways.

body.zh: 流量/压力与流场影响传质、温度分布与界面反应均匀性。
body.en: Flow / pressure and flow field Affect mass transfer, temperature distribution And interfacial-reaction uniformity.

body.zh: 氢安全、材料兼容与冷却气氛关注材料相容性、金属腐蚀及冷却阶段气氛。
body.en: Hydrogen safety, material compatibility And cooling ambient Consider material compatibility, metal Corrosion and the ambient during cooling.

body.zh: 形成气可能降低部分界面陷阱效果依材料而变，并需权衡氢稳定性、金属兼容和薄膜应力。
body.en: Forming gas may reduce some interface traps The effect depends on the material; tradeoffs include Hydrogen stability, metal compatibility and film stress.

body.zh: 惰性气氛可减少非目标氧化不会自动完成界面钝化或目标化学反应。
body.en: Inert ambients can reduce unintended oxidation They do not automatically passivate interfaces or Complete the target chemical reaction.

body.zh: 风险取决于材料、泄漏、气体纯度与热轨迹。
body.en: Risk depends on Materials, leaks, Gas purity and The thermal trajectory.

body.zh: 量测反馈：XPS / SIMS · FTIR · C–V / G–V · 接触电阻 · 膜应力
body.en: Metrology feedback: XPS / SIMS · FTIR · C–V / G–V · contact resistance · film stress

body.zh: 同一种气氛在不同金属、介质、节点和热处理平台上，作用与窗口都可能不同。
body.en: The same ambient can have different effects and process windows for different metals, dielectrics, nodes and thermal-processing platforms.
